name: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin)
summary: A cobalt-containing vitamin required for DNA synthesis, red-cell maturation and myelin maintenance; a cofactor for methionine synthase and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase.

conditions.label: Deficiency
conditions.description: Impairs DNA synthesis (megaloblastic anaemia) and myelin integrity (subacute combined degeneration).

affects.detail: Defective DNA synthesis produces large, immature red cells and hypersegmented neutrophils, causing fatigue, pallor and breathlessness.

affects.effect: Subacute combined degeneration of the spinal cord
affects.detail: Demyelination of the dorsal columns and corticospinal tracts causes numbness, tingling, loss of proprioception, unsteady gait and weakness — potentially irreversible if untreated.

ageModifiers.elderly: Common and easily missed in older adults; may present as cognitive decline or gait disturbance.

affects.effect: Cognitive changes, memory loss, mood disturbance
affects.detail: Deficiency can cause irritability, depression and reversible cognitive impairment.

affects.effect: Glossitis; often linked to loss of intrinsic factor
affects.detail: A smooth, sore (beefy-red) tongue is common; autoimmune atrophic gastritis removes intrinsic factor, the usual cause of pernicious anaemia.
